Hi Priya / Alex — thanks for these clear asks. Answers below at a high level; we can expand in the technical deep-dive and follow-on docs.

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II testing for our hosted and dedicated products in Q4 2026. We have a final report under NDA; procurement typically receives the report via our secure share after an NDA. I have a summarized controls mapping that I'll attach to the HubSpot deal.

2) Export formats & S3 Object Lock
- We support newline-delimited JSON exports and provide a manifest file with per-file SHA256 checksums. Exports can be pushed to your S3 bucket via a presigned multi-part upload or delivered to an S3 location we provision in your account. Both delivery modes can be compatible with S3 Object Lock (Governance mode) — customers typically configure bucket-level Object Lock and we deliver the export bundle where immutability is enforced by your S3 configuration.

3) Manifest, hashes, and signatures
- Our export manifest includes: job id, initiating user (Redwood user id or service principal), start/end timestamps, export filters (time range, log types), and per-file SHA256 hashes. We also offer optional signing of the manifest using our key (attached manifest-signature.asc) for a tamper-evident verification step.

4) Export audit trail
- Every export job is recorded in our admin activity logs with: job id, initiating principal, request and completion timestamps, and target delivery location. Those admin activity logs are included in the export bundle by default (or can be excluded if you prefer).

Attachments: auditlog_export_schema_sample.json contains field names and an example record for admin and API logs. The playbook outlines recommended patterns for long-term retention and verification (S3 Object Lock + manifest signing + periodic checksum audits).

- Alex: if procurement wants the SOC 2 report, I can share the summary and send the secure link once NDA is confirmed.
- Rishi / Priyom / Vivek: please confirm availability for Tue Apr 13 10:00–11:00 PDT — I will send a calendar invite.
